To determine how much fabric Luke needs to buy, we will follow these steps:

**Step 1: Calculate the total width of all the windows.**
There are 5 windows, and each window is 35 inches wide.
$$ \text{Total width} = \text{Number of windows} \times \text{Width per window} $$
$$ \text{Total width} = 5 \times 35 \text{ inches} $$
$$ \text{Total width} = 175 \text{ inches} $$

**Step 2: Calculate the amount of fabric needed.**
The problem states that Luke needs to buy fabric equal to 2 times the total width of the windows.
$$ \text{Fabric needed} = 2 \times \text{Total width} $$
$$ \text{Fabric needed} = 2 \times 175 \text{ inches} $$
$$ \text{Fabric needed} = 350 \text{ inches} $$

**Conclusion:**
Luke should buy 350 inches of fabric.

Final answer: 350
